apps.name: Meal Monster
apps.focus: Conversational logging and optional friend accountability
apps.summary: An iPhone tracker with meal descriptions, voice, food photos, supported barcodes, and optional accountability with trusted friends.
apps.strengthsToConsider: Consider it if conversational meal logging and a companion with earned skins appeal to you. The separate Supporter mode is for supporting friends, not free personal food logging.
apps.limitsToVerify: Personal logging requires Pro. Independent correction-burden and timing results have not been collected. Apple Health access is read-only.
apps.pricing: Pro is required for personal food logging. Check current offers and trial eligibility in the App Store.
apps.subtitle: AI Meal Log & Progress

voice.detail: The listing advertises speaking full meals.

photo.detail: The listing advertises adding meals from a food photo.

barcode.detail: The listing advertises packaged-food barcode logging; coverage varies.

editable.detail: The listing says estimates can be reviewed and corrected.

freeTracking.detail: Personal food logging and Progress require Pro after any offered trial. Free Supporter mode does not include logging.
